general.name: General
general.description: Catch-all for off-catalog questions. Use when none of the specialised topics fits — but prefer a specialised topic when one applies, so the human operator can read the queue at a glance.

clarify-scope.name: Clarify scope
clarify-scope.description: Boundaries / out-of-scope confirmation. The agent has hit a question about whether the work should include / exclude something the ticket didn't specify.

needs-arch-review.name: Needs architecture review
needs-arch-review.description: A cross-module impact or non-trivial design choice the agent isn't comfortable making alone. Prepare an outline of the options considered before invoking.

needs-security-review.name: Needs security review
needs-security-review.description: Auth, secrets, PII, threat-model, or supply-chain implications. Operator escalates to the security engineer.

needs-ux-input.name: Needs UX input
needs-ux-input.description: User-facing flow or copy that the operator should route to the designer.

blocked-on-data.name: Blocked on data
blocked-on-data.description: The agent needs facts not in the ticket — production traces, customer reports, prior incident notes — that the human operator can fetch.
